# Owen's published website: do not edit here

This repo is only the published copy of https://owenstef.github.io.
The source is `site/` in the repo `OwenStef/job-search-agent`.

A session started here should:
1. `add_repo` `OwenStef/job-search-agent` (access `push`) and clone it.
2. Read and follow `.claude/commands/site.md` there (the `/site` command) to
   edit, explain or publish.

Never edit files here by hand: the next publish overwrites them
(`scripts/site_publish.py` in that repo mirrors `site/` onto this one).
